parameters.query: SELECT id, raw_payload FROM public.raw_orders WHERE id = $1::bigint LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO public.canonical_orders (
  schema_version, source, external_ref, location_key, order_type, status,
  customer, items, payment, vat_lines, utm, raw_payload_id
) VALUES (
  '1.1', 'shopify'::public.order_source, $1, $2, $3::public.order_channel_type,
  'received'::public.order_state,
  $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, $9::bigint
)
ON CONFLICT (source, external_ref) DO UPDATE SET
  items = EXCLUDED.items,
  payment = EXCLUDED.payment,
  vat_lines = EXCLUDED.vat_lines,
  customer = EXCLUDED.customer,
  order_type = EXCLUDED.order_type,
  utm = COALESCE(canonical_orders.utm, EXCLUDED.utm),
  updated_at = now()
WHERE canonical_orders.location_key = EXCLUDED.location_key
RETURNING id, (xmax = 0) AS was_inserted, status

WITH inserted AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.canonical_orders WHERE source = 'shopify'::public.order_source AND external_ref = $1 LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE public.canonical_orders SET status = 'normalized'::public.order_state
 WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM inserted) AND status = 'received'::public.order_state
RETURNING id, status

SELECT public.pgmq_send_order(
  'q_orders_push_ls',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'canonical_id', (SELECT id FROM public.canonical_orders WHERE source='shopify'::public.order_source AND external_ref=$1 LIMIT 1)::text,
    'source',       'shopify',
    'external_ref', $1::text,
    'location_key', $2::text
  )
) AS msg_id
